quest.title: Small Jack Frost, Big Problems
quest.description: While exploring Snezhnaya, you stumble upon a strange settlement of Jack Frosts. They seem to be in the midst of some terrible trouble...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Somewhat Big Jack Frost
dialogues.text: Ya-ho—! Ya-ho—!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Is it trying to thank us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we can't understand a single word you're saying, but... you're welcome?

dialogues.speaker: Somewhat Big Jack Frost
dialogues.text: Ummm...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The somewhat big Jack Frost stares blankly for a second, then...\npulls a wooden slate from behind its back and starts scribbling away with its finger.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what's that...? Whoa! You actually know how to write?!

dialogues.speaker: Somewhat Big Jack Frost
dialogues.text: Ya-ho—!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon see... "Thank you, good people. I am the village chief."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, the chief! Well, you're welcome, chief.

dialogues.speaker: Somewhat Big Jack Frost
dialogues.text: Ya-ho—!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But wait, "chief" is what you do, not who you are. What's your actual name?

dialogues.speaker: Somewhat Big Jack Frost
dialogues.text: "Village chief."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, this is getting us nowhere... Let's just stick with "Chief" for now!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: Ya-ho—!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, Chief, what exactly happened around here?

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Volkodlaks. Invaded. Bullied..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... So they broke into your village and started pushing everyone around?

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Volkodlaks hard. Jack Frosts soft..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well... Yeah, their claws do look a whole lot harder than yours... But what are we supposed to do about that?

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Giant snowballs. Launch. Block!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, can we really block them with just snowballs?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Only if we stuff some stones inside...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where do you even come up with such terrifying ideas...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Don't look at him like you just changed its entire worldview! Putting rocks in snowballs is way too dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But come to think of it, do snowballs even work? If they did, those volkodlaks wouldn't have broken in here in the first place...

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Prime Ice. Hard. Launch. Cannon. Few..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! So you're trying to build some kind of Prime Ice cannon to launch the snowballs, but you guys ran out of time to assemble the mechanisms?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #If that's the case, {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I guess we could pitch in?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! It's not like we haven't crafted our fair share of weird Prime Ice stuffs before...

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Blond hair, big hero! White hair, soft but hard!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! "Soft but hard" doesn't sound like a compliment at all!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Come!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks it wants us to follow it. Let's go see what's up ahead!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Help cannon?"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, well let's see where else we need to place the prime ice mechanisms!

response.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
response.text: "Volkodlak, enter, path, elsewhere."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... You mean the volkodlaks will come from other paths, right? Paimon gets it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's see where else along those paths we can place the prime ice mechanisms!

response.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
response.text: "Ready, Chief, tell!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Got it. Just like before, we'll let you know as soon as we're ready.

choices.text: We'll be there to help you out later...

response.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
response.text: Ya-ho!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost with a tambourine
dialogues.text: Ya-ho... Ya-ho...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh dear, you poor little fella... There, there, we already those two big bullies!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost with a tambourine
dialogues.text: Ya-ho—!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost with a tambourine
dialogues.text: Ya-ho... Ya-ho...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, huh? Why are you still looking so down? Could it be because they took your Mora too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It doesn't look like it has pockets, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mora?

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost with a tambourine
dialogues.text: Hmm... Uhh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bullied!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost with a tambourine
dialogues.text: Ya-ho! Ya-ho!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still scared of being bullied? But we already ran those volkodlaks off...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Which means...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Where on earth did you pull that from!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, little guy, are there other friends of yours out there who are still in trouble?

response.speaker: Jack Frost with a tambourine
response.text: Ya-ho...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Waving hands like fluffy snowballs, this Jack Frost rattles its tiny tambourine as it tries to explain how its kin back home are being bullied by volkodlaks...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, those volkodlaks are the worst.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If we ever cross paths with your hometown, we'll make sure to teach them a lesson they won't forget!

response.speaker: Jack Frost with a tambourine
response.text: Ya-ho! Ya-hooo...

choices.text: Or maybe other Jack Frosts are being targeted too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, good thinking!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Volkodlak, enter, path."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... this is the path where the volkodlaks are coming from?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Combining the fragmented words on its slate with clumsy gestures, the chief tells you of the attacks that have long plagued their home...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're saying those bad volkodlaks invade this place just to bully you guys every now and then...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And they just stroll right down that path like they own the place,

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: taking whatever they want and leaving the whole area in a total mess!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, that's just terrible... Those volkodlaks really are the absolute worst!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I get it now! That's why you want to set up those giant snowball cannons right along this path...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And use the giant snowballs to chase them off!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: Ya-ho!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Help cannon!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, we'll help out with the cannons!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: Ya-ho—!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Ready, Chief, tell!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Got it, got it. We'll let you know as soon as we're ready!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: Ya-ho... Yahoo~

dialogues.speaker: Invading Volkodlak
dialogues.text: Ugh, it's not worth it if we keep going like this...

dialogues.speaker: Invading Volkodlak
dialogues.text: Darn it, I was planning to get my money back this way... Now the money I paid for help has gone up in smoke!

dialogues.speaker: Invading Volkodlak
dialogues.text: Looks like I'll have to find another way. Hmph! C-Consider yourselves lucky, you Jack Frosts!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That should keep them from ever coming back...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: After all, every single path leading in here is already full of prime ice traps and mechanisms.

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: Ya-ho... *whimpers* Ya-ho—!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe! Paimon got it this time! That was definitely their way of saying thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't mention it.

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Finally, complete!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What is it up to this time...

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Come!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's running off again! Let's catch up and check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Flattened Jack Frost
dialogues.text: Ya-ho...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Looks like it's finally free.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, what are Jack Frosts actually made of anyway? Snow? It was trapped under there for ages, but it didn't even lose its shape...

dialogues.speaker: Flattened Jack Frost
dialogues.text: Ya-ho?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: N—no, it's nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, it's the chief, and a whole bunch of Jack Frosts. And what's that they're crowding around...

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Finally, completely!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do you mean, "finally, completely"? Paimon doesn't get it at all.

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: Ya-ho...

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Door, sign, snowball!"

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Fire, fire, fire!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're saying we should... shoot snowballs... at the sign on the door?

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "White hair, hard!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks she gets it now. So "hard" means Paimon is awesome, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, "finally, completely" means that when we "finally" finish this, the village will "completely" go back to the way it was... right?

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: Ya-ho!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon knew you were going to do that sooner or later!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, let's help you fix that sign on the door!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, okay! Paimon is hard.

dialogues.speaker: Dizzy Jack Frost
dialogues.text: Ya... Ya-oh-ho... Ohhhh

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you okay? Whoa, you made some really weird noises.

dialogues.speaker: Dizzy Jack Frost
dialogues.text: Uhh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Although you don't look too well yet, it doesn't seem to be anything serious...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew, looks like we've finally fixed up everything damaged by the volkodlaks! They really did a number on this place!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: At least it's back to the way it was.

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Thank you!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't mention it! Seeing your village back to normal makes us super happy too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But wait... why were those volkodlaks raiding you guys in the first place? From what they was saying, it sounds like there's a ton of valuable stuff hidden around here.

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: Ya-ho...

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Good. Stuff. Shop!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you have some awesome stuff inside your shop? Whoa, Paimon doesn't know why, but it feels like she can understand you perfectly now, chief!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And wait, Paimon never expected this place to actually be a shop! Is it your shop?

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Steal, bad... Trade, good!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're saying those volkodlaks wanted to loot your stuff, but since this is a shop, things are supposed to be traded for?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so you guys use Mora too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, it's not Mora?

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Bite-ons."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is that?

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Blond hair, white hair, good! Give, give!"

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The somewhat big Jack Frost reaches behind its back with both hands, pulling out a handful of clinking objects and placing them into your palms.\nYou instantly recognize them as...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that's what you meant by "bite-ons"!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ah, they're buttons!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Mora, heavy, bad!"

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Bite-ons, light! Wear, pretty!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that makes sense. Paimon guesses Jack Frosts don't really have any use for Mora anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, as long as we find more of these "bite-ons" — uh, buttons — we can use them to trade for stuff at your shop? Is that how this works?

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: Ya-ho!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! If we find any more of these buttons, we'll definitely bring them straight to you!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Bite-ons, bite-ons, good!"

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: Ya-ho ya-ho!

talks.objective: Investigate the source of the massive ya-ho
Follow the village chief to the entrance

Help place two assault-type snowball launchers

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Ready, Chief, tell!"

response.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
response.text: Ya-ho!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: And so, before the volkodlaks arrive, you wrap up your preparations alongside the Jack Frosts as you set up the defensive fortifications.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Just as expected, it isn't long before a horde of volkodlaks comes into view at the end of the path.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, now let's see if those prime ice mechanisms are of any use!

response.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
response.text: Y...Ya-ho...

talks.objective: Hold your ground against the Volkodlak

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Ready, Chief, tell!"

response.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
response.text: Ya-ho!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: And so, before the volkodlaks arrive for the second time, you wrap up your preparations alongside the Jack Frosts as you set up the defensive fortifications.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: It isn't long before a horde of volkodlaks comes into view at the end of the path. In a way, they're quite persistent...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe! Now every path they take is full of mechanisms!

response.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
response.text: Y...Ya-ho...

dialogues.speaker: Invading Volkodlak
dialogues.text: D—Darn it, since when did these stupid Jack Frosts become such a pain?

dialogues.speaker: Invading Volkodlak
dialogues.text: J-Just you wait! We're gonna gather the whole pack and roll you up into snowballs!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We did it! These cannons are pretty awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: Ya-ho... Ohhh... Ya-ho—!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, but we can't let our guard down just yet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The volkodlaks who just fled said they'd be back with backup...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You weren't listening to a single word they said, were you?

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: *whimper*

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Blond hair, white hair, run!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #We're not exactly scared, are we, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: I'm so scared! Save yourself, Paimon! Run!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! You never miss a chance to be dramatic, do you?!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But anyway, we won't just sit idly by!

response.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
response.text: Ya-ho!

response.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
response.text: "Rest? Continue?"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you asking us if we want to rest for a while or keep helping with the prep work?

response.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
response.text: Ya-ho! Ya-ho!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, well let's see where else we need to place the prime ice mechanisms!

response.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
response.text: "Volkodlak, enter, path, elsewhere."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you mean there are other paths they could invade from? Paimon gets it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's see where else along those paths we can place the prime ice mechanisms!

response.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
response.text: "Ready, Chief, tell!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Got it. Just like before, we'll let you know as soon as we're ready.

response.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
response.text: Ya-ho!

choices.text: I wouldn't be scared even if there were ten times as many.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, if there really were ten times as many, that would be pretty exhausting!

Repair the sign using the snowball launcher

dialogues.text: Ya-ho!

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Door, sign, snowball!"

dialogues.speaker: Jack Frost "Village Head"
dialogues.text: "Fire, fire, fire!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, we know what to do now!
